dishes.name: Zesty Berry Yogurt Bowl
dishes.title: Greek yogurt with fresh berries and honey toast
dishes.method: Toast the bread. Top the yogurt with fresh berries and a drizzle of honey. Serve the toast on the side.
dishes.why: A quick, high-protein start to the muscle gain stretch with berries as the loud vegetable.

dishes.name: Golden Oregano Chicken & Grains
dishes.title: Lemon and oregano chicken with bulgur and green beans
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken, bulgur, and green bean portions in a wide pan with a splash of water until steaming. Top with fresh parsley.
dishes.why: Starch follows the training session to fuel muscle growth, using the first batch of the week.

dishes.name: Pan-Seared Cod & Braised Beans
dishes.title: Seared white fish with tomato-braised green beans
dishes.method: Season the cod and sear in a hot pan with oil for 3-4 minutes per side. Reheat the braised beans in a separate pan and serve alongside with a squeeze of lemon.
dishes.why: A warm element is essential for dinner; the white fish is safe for Peregrine's colour preferences.

dishes.name: Savoury Mushroom Scramble
dishes.title: Scrambled eggs with garlicky mushrooms on toast
dishes.method: Sauté sliced mushrooms and garlic in butter. Scramble the eggs in the same pan. Serve on toast, which can be eaten easily while the kitchen is being painted.
dishes.why: Mushrooms provide the loud vegetable element without using colours Peregrine avoids.

dishes.name: Lemon Chicken Grain Bowl
dishes.title: Cold lemon chicken with bulgur and green beans
dishes.method: Since the kitchen table is covered, this can be eaten cold as a hearty grain bowl or gently warmed in a pan if space allows. Mix the chicken, bulgur, and beans together.
dishes.why: A portable, bowl-based meal for a day when the kitchen is under dust sheets.

dishes.name: Spinach & Red Lentil Broth
dishes.title: Hearty lentil soup with wilted spinach
dishes.method: Reheat the lentil and spinach soup in a pot until bubbling. Serve in deep bowls with plenty of black pepper.
dishes.why: A warm, comforting bowl-food dinner that doesn't require a dining table.

dishes.name: Morning Berry & Yogurt Pot
dishes.title: Greek yogurt with berries and honeyed toast
dishes.method: Toast the bread. Assemble the yogurt pot by topping with berries and honey. Serve immediately.
dishes.why: Consistency in the breakfast routine helps maintain the muscle gain volume.

dishes.name: Warming Lentil & Spinach Soup
dishes.title: Red lentil soup with spinach and leeks
dishes.method: Reheat the soup in a small pan. Serve with a slice of bread for extra starch.
dishes.why: Utilises the final portion of the lentil batch for a quick, high-fibre lunch.

dishes.name: Beef & Broccoli Stir-Fry
dishes.title: Sizzling beef strips with ginger and broccoli
dishes.method: Stir-fry the beef strips in oil over high heat until browned. Add the broccoli florets and garlic with a splash of water, cover for 2 minutes to steam-fry until the broccoli is bright green.
dishes.why: Broccoli is the loud vegetable here; the ingredients for Sunday's traybake are now in your pantry.

preparations.title: Lemon and Oregano Roast Chicken (Part 1)
preparations.method: Rub chicken with oil, oregano, and lemon zest. Roast at 200°C for 35-40 minutes until golden and cooked through.

preparations.title: Lemon and Oregano Roast Chicken (Part 2)
preparations.method: Cooked in the same tray as Part 1. Roast at 200°C for 35-40 minutes.

preparations.title: Herby Bulgur Wheat (Part 1)
preparations.method: Simmer bulgur in stock for 10-12 minutes until water is absorbed. Fluff with a fork.

preparations.title: Herby Bulgur Wheat (Part 2)
preparations.method: Cooked in the same pot as Part 1. Simmer until absorbed.

preparations.title: Tomato Braised Green Beans (Part 1)
preparations.method: Sauté onion and garlic. Add beans and tomatoes. Simmer for 20 minutes until beans are tender.

preparations.title: Tomato Braised Green Beans (Part 2)
preparations.method: Cooked as part of the same batch as Part 1.

preparations.title: Tomato Braised Green Beans (Part 3)
preparations.method: Cooked as part of the same batch as Part 1.

preparations.title: Spinach & Red Lentil Soup (Part 1)
preparations.method: Sauté sliced leeks. Add lentils and stock. Simmer for 20 minutes. Stir in spinach at the end until wilted.

preparations.title: Spinach & Red Lentil Soup (Part 2)
preparations.method: Cooked as part of the same batch as Part 1.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Oven on for the chicken trays. While they roast, start the large pot of bulgur and the large pot for the green bean braise. Once the beans are simmering, start the lentil soup in a third pot. While everything simmers, chop the spinach and parsley. Box all portions as soon as they are cooked to clear the kitchen.

member_portions.portion_note: Larger protein and starch share; add a spoonful of blackcurrant jam to your breakfast toast.

preparation_shares.note: Full box plus extra chicken from the tray

member_portions.portion_note: Child-size share; always cut the crusts off the bread before serving.
Larger protein and starch share; ensure no carrots or orange-coloured foods are on the plate.
Child-size share; provide the bottle of hot sauce for every meal.
